---
title: "Troubleshooting"
---

## Nextflow is not found

Check whether `nextflow` is on your `PATH`:

```bash
which nextflow
```

If it is missing, add the install location to your shell profile.

## Docker is not running

Check Docker:

```bash
docker info
```

If this fails, open Docker Desktop or restart the Docker service.

## A run failed halfway through

Use `-resume` after fixing the problem:

```bash
nextflow run nf-core/rnaseq \
  -profile docker \
  --input samplesheet.csv \
  --outdir results/rnaseq \
  --genome GRCh38 \
  -resume
```

## Disk space errors

Check the size of the work directory:

```bash
du -sh work results
```

Move large outputs to persistent storage before deleting anything.

## Where to look for help

- The terminal error message
- `.nextflow.log`
- `results/rnaseq/pipeline_info/`
- The nf-core pipeline documentation
- The nf-core Slack community
